title: New Anomaly Game!
author: Preparation_Few
selftext:
**How We Used AI While Developing Our 90s Mall Horror Game**

We're a two-person indie development team working on Lawncrest Mall, a psychological horror anomaly game set inside an abandoned 1990s shopping mall.

Throughout development, we've used AI as a supporting tool for brainstorming ideas, troubleshooting technical challenges, and refining gameplay concepts. One of the biggest challenges has been creating an atmosphere where players constantly question whether something has changed or whether they're just imagining it.

AI has been particularly helpful as a brainstorming partner when working through different anomaly ideas and gameplay scenarios. We still make the creative decisions ourselves, but having a tool to bounce ideas off has helped us explore possibilities and work through problems more efficiently.

We're curious how other small indie teams are incorporating AI into their development workflows. Are you primarily using it for coding assistance, creative brainstorming, or something completely different?

For anyone interested, Lawncrest Mall is on Steam:  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5348220/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5348220/)
